# Plot renewal 2026

Dear member,

It is time to renew your plot at Mill Lane Allotments for 2026.

The rent is £40 for the year, whatever the plot size. Please pay at the hut on any Saturday morning before 31 January.

If you do not want to keep your plot, please tell us by the same date so we can offer it to the next person on the waiting list.

Best wishes,

Lyn Moss, Secretary
